edge.label: The giant stands exactly ten grids south
edge.explanation: A level-50 Mage with Acid Spray faces an awake hill giant exactly max_range grids south — on the blast loop's excluded south edge. Acid Spray is the only live attack (20 mana blocks Frost Bolt). The original never counts the giant and finds nothing worth casting; the correction counts it at radius-scaled damage and sprays.
